definitions: A genus of Gram-negative, rod-shaped bacteria, many species of which are pathogenic to plants, animals, and humans.
Any bacterium belonging to the genus Pseudomonas.
examples: Pseudomonas aeruginosa is a common cause of hospital-acquired infections.
The scientist isolated a novel strain of Pseudomonas from the soil sample.
Some types of Pseudomonas are used in bioremediation.
